role: The shared living-entity renderer every mob renderer builds on: interpolated rotations, the model draw with culling off, the hurt/death overlay passes, the shadow, the brightness math, and the name-tag layer.

members.name: logger
members.note: static constant, grouped; logging only

members.name: RES_ITEM_GLINT
members.note: the armour glint: two texture-matrix passes, GL_SRC_COLOR, GL_ONE under GL_EQUAL

members.name: mainModel
members.note: each kind's boxes are its model_* builder (pose_model): the mob scenes and the clientframes recordings judge them

members.name: renderPassModel
members.note: the second passes (saddle, fur, slime outer, armour) re-pose and re-draw their boxes in raster_mobs_draw

members.name: RendererLivingEntity
members.note: the model and the shadow size per kind (draw_shadow's radius, fancy only)

members.name: setRenderPassModel
members.note: state setter

members.name: interpolateRotation
members.note: mob_yaw is the same shortest-arc interpolation

members.name: doRender
members.note: the model pass with culling off, the render passes, the equipped items (the player's stuck arrows first), the hurt and colour-multiplier passes under GL_EQUAL with the lightmap off, the shadow (fancy only) and the fire; name tags are unreachable (passSpecialRender)

members.name: renderModel
members.note: pose_model + the per-box draws through the shared rasterizer

members.name: renderLivingAt
members.note: the translate to the interpolated position and the scale(-1,-1,1) are folded into model_vertex's transform

members.name: rotateCorpse
members.note: the body yaw, the death roll to getDeathMaxRotation and the sleeping player's bed turn; the subclass overrides are in their records

members.name: renderSwingProgress
members.note: m.swing is the interpolated swing progress

members.name: handleRotationFloat
members.note: the per-kind rotation floats (squid tentacles, wolf tail, bat) arrive as mob_render_input fields

members.name: renderEquippedItems
members.note: empty in this class; subclasses override and are tracked per renderer

members.name: renderArrowsStuckInEntity
members.note: RenderPlayer's call, the player seen in third person: the boxList pick seeded by the entity id, the point in the box, the arrow pointing out of it, lighting off; the client's DataWatcher 9 a row behind the server's (idx-arrows-s1 100, 172, 180 within 1 px)

members.name: inheritRenderPass
members.note: the hurt flash over the armour and the eyes passes' additive second draw

members.name: shouldRenderPass
members.note: the subclass passes are raster_mobs_draw's branches (saddle, fur, eyes, slime outer, creeper armour, the armour layers)

members.name: func_82408_c
members.note: empty in this class

members.name: getColorMultiplier
members.note: 0 here; RenderCreeper's (the only override) is the white pass at the flash's fifth on the odd tenths of getCreeperFlashIntensity, under the hurt pass's GL_EQUAL (idx-hudfx-s1 289 to 300 within 5 px)

members.name: preRenderCallback
members.note: empty in this class; the per-kind scales are in model_vertex

members.name: passSpecialRender
members.note: a name tag draws when func_110813_b holds: RenderLiving's needs getAlwaysRenderNameTagForRender (NBT only) or a custom name on the pointed mob. A custom name comes from a named name tag, which needs the anvil (world.conf anvil = off: BlockAnvil.onBlockActivated returns false); the player's own is excluded (entity != renderManager.livingPlayer) and single player has no other player

members.name: func_110813_b
members.note: client-world gate; the native renders only client worlds

members.name: func_96449_a
members.note: see passSpecialRender

members.name: doRender
members.note: synthetic bridge

notes: The two-sided model draw, the brightness scalar, the burning brightness boost and the shadow radius formula are all in raster_mobs_draw/model_vertex/draw_shadow; the worldfx_hurt and dragon hurt scenes pin the overlay behavior. doRender's interpolateRotation at partial tick 1 and the corpse rotation are also in raster_mobs_player_preview for the inventory preview. lane/idxclient: the creeper's colour multiplier and the player's stuck arrows ported; name tags unreachable (no anvil to name a tag).
